stemMarkdown: Walking at 5 km/h a student reaches school 10 minutes late, and walking at 6 km/h he reaches 10 minutes early. Find the distance (in km) to the school. (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The two journeys differ in time by $10 + 10 = 20$ minutes $= 0.3333$ hours. If the distance is $d$, then $\dfrac{d}{5} - \dfrac{d}{6} = 0.3333$, giving $d = 10.0$ km.
